title: Make standard s-php-composer-scripts pass
body: Outcome: `krn standards check --record s-php-composer-scripts` no longer fails s-php-composer-scripts.

Why: adoption found this reflex standard failing: exit 1 from [ ! -f composer.json ] || node -e 'const s=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("composer.json","utf8")).scripts||{};const m=["test","lint"].filter...
